memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the measured tape remains risk-on with healthy breadth and normalizing volatility, but the macro label is internally unstable and credit is the principal unresolved watch. The confirmed US regime remains Q2 Reflation while its own axes read Q3, pending 5 of 7 confirmation sessions. Credit stress is the rising dominant radar component, yet the radar’s measured 21-session pullback frequency is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, so this is not a validated bearish edge or an all-clear. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly drain, while systematic flows are aligned adding and dealer gamma is long. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no factor-attention history, and no tradeable composite. No signal, trade, ranking change, or escalation is originated here.
what_fired: Four shadow attention items were recorded: the pending Q2-to-Q3 label transition; credit-versus-tape divergence; rising put-skew contradiction across nine US buy-lane names; and review of the open China-equities overweight thesis.

One metabolism hypothesis was registered for later testing: under risk-on breadth with credit-dominant radar deterioration, credit-sensitive relative performance may weaken before an index drawdown. Its pre-committed gate requires a median lead of at least 3 days across at least 20 comparable observations.
memo.contradictions_review: The confluence graph reports two current contradictions. First, 18 ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences are reflected in the briefing; this is a note-level descriptive conflict. Second, nine buy-lane names have five-day-rising OTM-put skew as of 2026-08-13; this can only de-escalate confidence and is stale relative to the 2026-08-21 tape. Pair G factor contradictions are dormant because the panel has not reached 60 distinct dates. The broader macro tension is risk-on price/breadth and aligned systematic adding versus contracting liquidity, restrictive real yields, and rising credit-radar intensity. The risk radar itself remains below its measured pullback base rate and has no validated firing leg, limiting the interpretation to attention context. The open China-equities overweight thesis conflicts with current China/HK Q4 contracting-liquidity states, weak-side HK peg context, and southbound outflow into hot turnover; this deserves review, not a contrary position.
decaying_families: Radar: Q2 five-day and 21-day signed-excess estimates are negative; the engine is unarmed despite large samples.
US board: Q2 five-day and ten-day signed-excess estimates are negative, and pooled out-of-sample performance loses; unarmed.
Policy and White House families: negative signed-excess estimates with limited or modest effective samples; unarmed.
AI, stock, and thematic desks: negative 63-day signed-excess estimates in Q2 and overall; all unarmed.
Factor composite: non-tradeable, with investment, low-volatility, low-beta, and composite legs carrying negative historical IC in a survivorship-biased scorecard.
deserves_operator: US regime label transition: verify whether raw Q3 completes 7 of 7 sessions while growth remains negative and inflation positive; otherwise resolve the attention item if growth returns non-negative before confirmation.

Credit-versus-tape divergence: retain attention only if the credit sub-score reaches 70 or HY OAS widens at least 25 bp while breadth remains above 65% over the 200-day average; remove if credit falls below 50 and HY OAS stays at or below 2.75% without a positive 20-day change.

Options contradiction: on the next refresh, resolve if at least 7 of 9 affected buy-lane names no longer show rising five-day put skew; retain only if at least 6 remain skew-rising and their median ten-day excess return is negative.

Master-brain China-equities overweight thesis mb-2026-07-09-1: review because current China/HK context conflicts with it. Resolve if China moves to Q1/Q2, southbound flow improves above -0.5 z, and the HK peg leaves weak-side; retain if China stays Q4 while southbound flow remains below -1 z or FXI underperforms SPY by 5% through the thesis window.

Ledger hygiene: multiple open master-brain theses are past their check-by dates but remain unscored, including semiconductor, Bitcoin, China, Treasury, credit, and US-equity theses. This is an accountability and decay issue, not evidence for a new view.
